question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A post without any remuneration
solution:
The correct answer is: **Honorary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Honorary"** refers to holding a position without the usual requirements or responsibilities, often without financial compensation. (समानित)

 
 
• **Example:** She received an honorary degree from the university for her contributions to science.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Honorary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Illegible** (अपठनीय): Not clear enough to be read.

 
 
• **Example:** His handwriting was so illegible that the teacher asked him to rewrite the essay.
 
 
 
• **Bigot** (कट्टर): A person who is intolerant toward those holding different opinions.
 
 
• **Example:** The bigot refused to consider any new ideas that conflicted with his own beliefs.
 
 
 
• **Effeminate** (स्त्रैण): Having traits traditionally considered feminine.
 
 
• **Example:** He was often teased for his effeminate gestures, which didn't fit the traditional image of masculinity.
